commands.review_summary:
Adds an opt-in Claude setting that runs `cswap --list --json`, parses schema-v1 claude-swap account usage into provider-neutral snapshots, renders stacked Claude menu cards, documents setup, and adds parser/reader/projection/menu tests.

Reproducibility: yes. for the blocking patch defect: source inspection shows the adapter is awaited before the normal Claude fetch, and its subprocess timeouts are 10s/30s. I did not run live provider or Keychain validation per repository policy.

target.title: Add opt-in read-only claude-swap adapter for Claude multi-account usage
target.body:
## Summary

Phase 1 of the accepted multi-account design in [`docs/claude-multi-account-and-status-items.md`](https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/blob/main/docs/claude-multi-account-and-status-items.md) (#1812): an **opt-in, read-only [claude-swap](https://github.com/realiti4/claude-swap) adapter** that shows session + weekly usage for every claude-swap account as stacked cards in the Claude menu, normalized behind a provider-neutral account snapshot.

Addresses the Claude-subscription side of #1756 and #1268.

## What it does

- **Preferences → Providers → Claude** gains a "Read accounts from claude-swap" toggle (default **off**) and an executable-path field (shown only when enabled). Status text shows detected `cswap` version, account count, last refresh, and adapter errors.
- When enabled, each Claude refresh also executes exactly the argument array `cswap --list --json` — never a shell, never config-defined passthrough arguments — with a 30 s timeout and a 256 KiB stdout bound.
- The strict schema-v1 parser requires `schemaVersion == 1`, rejects unknown versions and partial top-level shapes, surfaces the JSON error envelope from non-zero exits, and decodes **only** the allow-listed fields: slot number, active state, usage status, email (display-only), and the 5-hour/7-day windows (pct + resetsAt). Sentinel statuses (`token_expired`, `api_key`, `keychain_unavailable`, `no_credentials`, `unavailable`) render as per-account notes; unknown future sentinels degrade gracefully.
- Rows project into the provider-neutral model proposed by the design doc — `ProviderAccountUsageSnapshot` / `ProviderAccountIdentity` — with identity `claude-swap:<slot>` (never email- or credential-derived).
- With more than one account, the Claude menu renders one stacked card per account (active account first), reusing the existing Kilo multi-scope card path (`menuCardModel` + `addStackedMenuCards`). With zero or one account, or with the toggle off, **nothing changes**.
- Hide Personal Info redacts account emails through the existing `PersonalInfoRedactor` card path.

## Contract compliance (Phase 1 adapter contract)

- ✅ Disabled by default; user chooses the executable path explicitly.
- ✅ Fixed argv `--list --json`; no shell; no other claude-swap commands ever invoked (no `--switch`, `auto`, `add`, export/import/purge).
- ✅ `schemaVersion == 1` required; unknown versions and partial shapes rejected.
- ✅ Bounded runtime + stdout; timeout terminates the process tree (existing `SubprocessRunner`); the last successful snapshot is retained as stale data on failure.
- ✅ CodexBar never reads claude-swap storage, Claude Code storage, or Keychain entries for this feature; the subprocess is solely responsible for its own credential access. Raw stdout is never logged or persisted; account snapshots stay in memory.
- ✅ Adapter failure is fully isolated from the ambient Claude usage card; users without claude-swap see no behavior change.
- ✅ No account switching; deferred per the doc.
- Out of scope, as sequenced by the doc: per-account status items (needs the account snapshots from this PR to land first).

## Implementation notes

- `SubprocessRunner.run` gains a defaulted `acceptsNonZeroExit` parameter because claude-swap prints its schema-v1 error envelope to **stdout** with a non-zero exit; existing call sites are untouched.
- Refresh/menu wiring deliberately mirrors the Kilo multi-scope pattern (store array + `refreshProvider` hook + stacked cards + menu identity signature) rather than the heavier managed-account machinery, keeping the UI surface small per the #1707 post-mortem.
- Config: two new optional fields on the Claude `ProviderConfig` entry (`claudeSwapEnabled`, `claudeSwapExecutablePath`) in `~/.codexbar/config.json`.

## Tests

Fake executables only — no real claude-swap, no credentials, no Keychain access (24 new tests):

- `ClaudeSwapListParserTests` — schema v1 payload, empty list, error envelope, unknown schema version, missing top-level/row fields, invalid percentages (string/bool/non-finite), invalid timestamps, fractional-second timestamps, out-of-range pct clamping, all sentinel statuses incl. unknown values.
- `ClaudeSwapAccountReaderTests` — fake `cswap` shell scripts: parse success, error envelope on non-zero exit, timeout termination, oversized-output rejection, missing executable, version probe (success/failure), tilde expansion.
- `ClaudeSwapAccountProjectionTests` — provider-neutral projection: active-first ordering, window mapping (300/10080 min), sentinel → per-account error text, ordinal label fallback for empty emails.
- `MenuCardClaudeSwapAccountTests` — menu-model: projected account renders session/weekly metrics + identity; Hide Personal Info redacts the email.

## Commands run

- `swift build`
- `swift test --filter ClaudeSwap` (22 tests) and `--filter MenuCardClaudeSwapAccount` (2 tests)
- `make test` (full sharded suite)
- `make check` (SwiftFormat + SwiftLint, 0 violations)
